text:
Use with caution / monitor

Administration of oral amiodarone results in an increase in serum digoxin concentration, raising it by 70% after just one day [amiodarone:drug_interactions:4, amiodarone:drug_interactions:9]. Because of this interaction, the label recommends reducing the dose of digoxin by half or discontinuing it, and closely monitoring serum levels and patients for clinical evidence of toxicity [amiodarone:drug_interactions:4].
